newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daido Hoxan, Air Products to form Japan gas venture.
newsitem.headline: Daido Hoxan, Air Products to form Japan gas venture.

text.p: Japanese industrial gas producer Daido Hoxan Corp said on Tuesday that it and Air Products and Chemicals Inc of the United States would set up a joint venture in Japan in January to produce and market industrial gases.

The move is aimed at taking advantage of surging demand from semiconductor manufacturers. The companies also hope to tap rapidly growing markets in Asia outside of Japan, a Daido Hoxan spokesman said.

The joint venture, Daido Air Products Electronics Inc, will be capitalised at 300 million yen and based in Osaka, western Japan. Daido Hoxan will own 51 percent of the firm and Air Products will hold the rest, the spokesman said.
The firm's gas products will include nitrogen and nitrogen trifluoride. The firm's first-year sales are expected to total seven billion yen, the spokesman said.
Air Products is the largest shareholder in Daido Hoxan with a 9.1 percent stake as of the end of March.
